comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Underwrites specialty commercial risk and earns premiums; eHealth is a commission-based consumer broker, not a carrier.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Commission-earning insurance broker placing policies with carriers, though commercial P&C focused rather than Medicare-focused.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Sells leads and referrals to carriers on per-lead fees; does not enroll customers or earn policy commissions.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Annuity and life carrier earning investment spread and premiums; eHealth is an intermediary, not a risk-bearing insurer.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Consumer-facing agency earning carrier commissions on placed policies by phone and online, similar intermediary model.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: HSA custody and benefits administration earning account fees and interest; not insurance distribution.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions, including employee benefits and personal lines, though mostly commercial.
